info.title: FPS Control Plane
info.description: Canonical HTTP contract for the control plane. Generated from source.

AllocatedPort.description:
Host publish for one template port. TCP and UDP on the same container port
share a host port number when both are listed.

error_code.description: Optional machine code (`port_conflict`) so the control plane can retry.

Permission.description:
Canonical permission identifiers. Backend enforcement and frontend capability
display must use these exact strings. The frontend is never the security boundary.

Role.description: Platform roles. Permissions are derived from these plus future scoped grants.
